purpose: Versioned runtime contracts for the collect/live/mobile engines. One JSON per collection operation. Schema + drift semantics: internal/contracts. Adaptation workflow: adapt/playbook/AGENTS.md.
rules: breaking binding/path change bumps 'version' and keeps the old file as <name>-vN.json
additive field mapping stays in the same version
version is the consumers' pin; code never hardcodes endpoint paths
README.json itself is not loaded as a contract
